hero.title:
The CRM that keeps your gym's
pulse beating.
hero.subtitle: Say goodbye to month-end guesswork. Revenue, collection health, and retention metrics centralized in dashboards that guide your decisions.

carousel.label: Used by gym chains and independent studios across Brazil

product.title: Your gym's financial control, in one place.
product.description: Stop switching between spreadsheets and guessing your results. Pulse brings all your revenue data into a single panel. Easy to read, essential for growth.

billing.title: Revenue & Sales
billing.description: Track revenue trends, average ticket, and sales volume. Get absolute clarity on daily, weekly, or monthly billing.

collection.title: Collection Health
collection.description: Monitor received amounts, pending balances, and collection rate. Spot cash flow bottlenecks before month-end.

retention.title: Acquisition vs. Retention
retention.description: Know exactly where your money comes from. Analyze the ratio between new members and renewals throughout the year.

payments.title: Payment Analysis
payments.description: Map your customers' purchase behavior. See sales distribution by payment method and optimize your fees.

potencialize.title: Connect your current system with one click.
potencialize.description: Sync your account with EVO, Next Fit, Tecnofit, and even WhatsApp. Our platform automatically extracts your member and payment history to generate smart financial dashboards — no spreadsheet exports or manual data entry.
potencialize.dashboardAlt: Pulse dashboard integrated with gym system

demo.title: Discover Pulse's impact on your management.
demo.description: Book 30 minutes and see our platform in action with your own data. No canned demos — just your real problems being solved.

benefits.noCard: No credit card and no commitment.

benefits.cashFlow: Uncover hidden opportunities in your cash flow.
